protocol.sampling: same deterministic np default_rng(seed) canonical TRAIN origin sequence as parent; 512 with replacement each epoch
protocol.encoder_selection: earliest full VAL reconstruction minimum incl0, separately prefix0..60 and0..180
protocol.decoder_weight_sharing: same architecture/fitting/selection rule; separate coefficients per latent coordinate and milestone
protocol.ridge_feature_scaling: TRAIN-only per-feature RMS, no centering/intercept; coefficients rescaled back to original feature coordinates
protocol.precision: E/F/neuralD FP32; ridge features/stats/coeff/fittedD accumulation FP64; final prediction FP32

benchmark.isolation: fresh process per dataset/adapter benchmark case, separated from training; rotate family case order across dataset/seed blocks; identical input origins

MLP_POINT_seed92601.wall_scope: per-fit wall includes training, full VAL reconstruction, checkpoint saves, and curve writes

checkpoint_state_at_parent_best_epoch.tolerance: max_abs<=5e-5; CUDA bitwise equality is not assumed

parent_prefix_parity.failure_interpretation: If false, legacy-vs-extended attribution is blocked; 0..60 and 0..180 remain valid within this fresh trajectory.
